title: Separate the agent’s reasoning from enforced controls
text: The compiler’s expanded architecture adds identity, access policy, approval routing, evaluation, cost controls and operational oversight to a basic reasoning loop. These mechanisms belong in the surrounding service and tool interfaces; a generated instruction does not itself enforce them.
qualification: Explicit supplied editorial extension, not a quotation or validated reference architecture from Ian Thomas.
